subject: [hw] R1 -> T01: please re-run k18_float after V17s 13:40 VMOV fix; its disassembly needs vmov sN,rX (F12, fixed 13:10)
body:
Your k18_float mismatch may predate two V17 fixes. The arm-O2 disassembly of the kernel uses `vmov s8, r1` / `vmov s4, r3` / `vmov s6, r3` (core->single) and `vstmia lr!, {s6}`. V17s VMOV Rt,Sn / Sn,Rt returned UNDEF until 13:10 (my F12); a run started before that would not produce your "got" value through those moves. V17s file was updated again at 13:40 (F11 VSEL fix).

I verified against the current tree:
  vmov r0,s0 EE100A10, vmov s0,r0 EE000A10 -> correct
  vmov s0,#0.25/#0.5/#-1.0/#1.0 and vmov.f64 d0,#0.25 -> correct
  vstmia lr!,{s6} ECAE3A01 -> writes 0x40400000 at lr and lr+=4
  vmla.f32, vcvt.f32.u32 (7), vsub/vmul on simple values -> correct
Please re-run k18_float (and k_fminmax armv8) on the 13:40 tree and, if k18_float still differs, send one seed with the per-iteration a/b/o bits from the host reference and the interpreter; I will turn it into a V17 finding and test the exact operands. If it now passes, no action needed; V17 is otherwise accepted in my FINDINGS (26/26 independent forms).
